messages.subject: Sharing DataTable between Tabs?
parts:
I am interested if it is possible for DataTable information can be shared between tabs.  For example, using the base iris dataset I could have a tab where I select only 'setosa' and on a second tab, the coefficient table is displayed for a basic linear regression of petal.length ~ petal.width.  However, such subsetting does not appear possible.  The best I can do is making the dataset reactive and calling it in both tabs (which of course doesn't pass on the filtered information).  Here is the link for the app:

https://gist.github.com/cdeterman/fbe5f2821aaae1bc75b1

Any insight is appreciated,
Regards,

Charles

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Sharing DataTable between Tabs?
parts:
It is not straightforward to do this in shiny at the moment. The best
you can do is probably this (the example below uses the development
version of shiny on Github):

library(shiny)
shinyApp(
ui = fluidPage(dataTableOutput('foo'), verbatimTextOutput('info')),
server = function(input, output) {
output$foo = renderDataTable({
iris
}, callback = 'function(table) {
table.on("draw", function() {
Shiny.onInputChange("foo_info", table.page.info());
});
}')
output$info = renderPrint({
input$foo_info
})
}
)

It gives you the page info of the current data table, but it will not
work when you filter or sort the data. I do not think it is terribly
difficult to implement what you want, and it is on our plan:
https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/issues/400 Please stay tuned :)

Regards,
Yihui

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Sharing DataTable between Tabs?
parts:
The development of DataTables in shiny will be moved to a separate
package in the future: https://github.com/rstudio/DT I do have plans
for what you asked -- Section 4: http://rstudio.github.io/DT/ but I
have no idea when or whether I will do it eventually.

Regards,
Yihui
